title: ReqPub evidence pack manifest
description: manifest.json inside an evidence pack: every other file in the pack with its SHA-256 over exact bytes, per docs/VERIFY.md section 11. Verification is strict both ways: a listed file missing or changed fails, and a file present but unlisted fails. generatedAt lives only here so per-file hashes stay deterministic. Additive-only within formatVersion 1.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 moment of production. Appears in no other file of the pack.

recipe.description: The manifest recipe restated in words.

name.description: Path inside the pack, forward slashes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 over the exact bytes of the named file.
